<module id="multi_pipe_8bit">
    <description>Unsigned 8bit Multiplier using pipelined processing.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal. Defined as 0 for chip reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="mul_en_in">Input enable signal that controls the multiplication operation.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[7:0]">Input signal representing the multiplicand with a data width of 8 bits.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[7:0]">Input signal representing the multiplier with a data width of 8 bits.</input>
        <output id="mul_en_out">Output enable signal indicating if the multiplication operation is enabled.</output>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[15:0]">Product output signal with a data width of 16 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        // Register declarations
        reg [15:0] mul_out_reg;
        reg [7:0] mul_a_reg, mul_b_reg;
        reg [7:0] temp[7:0];
        reg [15:0] sum[7:0];
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of the clock signal
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                // Reset condition: Set mul_en_out_reg to 0 when reset is active
                mul_en_out_reg <= 0;
            end else begin
                // Update mul_en_out_reg with the current value of mul_en_in
                mul_en_out_reg <= mul_en_in;
            end
        end
        
        // Assigning the output enable signal to the most significant bit of mul_en_out_reg
        assign mul_en_out = mul_en_out_reg[7];
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of the clock signal
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                // Reset condition: Set mul_a_reg to 0 when reset is active
                mul_a_reg <= 0;
            end else if (mul_en_in == 1) begin
                // Update mul_a_reg with the current value of mul_a when mul_en_in is active
                mul_a_reg <= mul_a;
            end
        end
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of the clock signal
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                // Reset condition: Set mul_b_reg to 0 when reset is active
                mul_b_reg <= 0;
            end else if (mul_en_in == 1) begin
                // Update mul_b_reg with the current value of mul_b when mul_en_in is active
                mul_b_reg <= mul_b;
            end
        end
        
        // Combinational logic to generate partial products based on the multiplier bits
        genvar i;
        generate
            for(i = 0; i < 8; i=i+1) begin : gen_partial_products
                assign temp[i] = {8{mul_b_reg[i]}} & mul_a_reg;
            end
        endgenerate
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of the clock signal
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                // Reset condition: Set sum[0] to 0 when reset is active
                sum[0] <= 0;
            end else if (mul_en_in == 1) begin
                // Update sum[0] with the current value of temp[0] when mul_en_in is active
                sum[0] <= temp[0];
            end
        end
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of the clock signal
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                // Reset condition: Set sum[1] to 0 when reset is active
                sum[1] <= 0;
            end else if (mul_en_in == 1) begin
                // Update sum[1] with the current value of temp[1] shifted left by 1 when mul_en_in is active
                sum[1] <= temp[1] << 1;
            end
        end
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of the clock signal
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                // Reset condition: Set sum[2] to 0 when reset is active
                sum[2] <= 0;
            end else if (mul_en_in == 1) begin
                // Update sum[2] with the current value of temp[2] shifted left by 2 when mul_en_in is active
                sum[2] <= temp[2] << 2;
            end
        end
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of the clock signal
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                // Reset condition: Set sum[3] to 0 when reset is active
                sum[3] <= 0;
            end else if (mul_en_in == 1) begin
                // Update sum[3] with the current value of temp[3] shifted left by 3 when mul_en_in is active
                sum[3] <= temp[3] << 3;
            end
        end
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of the clock signal
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                // Reset condition: Set sum[4] to 0 when reset is active
                sum[4] <= 0;
            end else if (mul_en_in == 1) begin
                // Update sum[4] with the current value of temp[4] shifted left by 4 when mul_en_in is active
                sum[4] <= temp[4] << 4;
            end
        end
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of the clock signal
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                // Reset condition: Set sum[5] to 0 when reset is active
                sum[5] <= 0;
            end else if (mul_en_in == 1) begin
                // Update sum[5] with the current value of temp[5] shifted left by 5 when mul_en_in is active
                sum[5] <= temp[5] << 5;
            end
        end
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of the clock signal
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                // Reset condition: Set sum[6] to 0 when reset is active
                sum[6] <= 0;
            end else if (mul_en_in == 1) begin
                // Update sum[6] with the current value of temp[6] shifted left by 6 when mul_en_in is active
                sum[6] <= temp[6] << 6;
            end
        end
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of the clock signal
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                // Reset condition: Set sum[7] to 0 when reset is active
                sum[7] <= 0;
            end else if (mul_en_in == 1) begin
                // Update sum[7] with the current value of temp[7] shifted left by 7 when mul_en_in is active
                sum[7] <= temp[7] << 7;
            end
        end
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of the clock signal
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                // Reset condition: Set mul_out_reg to 0 when reset is active
                mul_out_reg <= 0;
            end else if (mul_en_in == 1) begin
                // Update mul_out_reg with the sum of all elements in the sum array when mul_en_in is active
                mul_out_reg <= sum[0] + sum[1] + sum[2] + sum[3] + sum[4] + sum[5] + sum[6] + sum[7];
            end
        end
        
        // Conditional assignment to drive the output port based on the output enable signal
        assign mul_out = mul_en_out ? mul_out_reg : 0;
    </implementation>
</module>
